title: Chota
summary: A location-based directory to help people find shops and businesses in their city, launching first in Eket.

caseStudy.overview: A directory that improves local businesses' visibility, with Eket as the first market.
caseStudy.problem: Local shops and businesses have little visibility online, which makes them hard to discover.

decisions.title: Launch in one city first
decisions.body: Eket is the initial launch market and case study, so listings and recommendations can be built up properly in one place before expanding.
